searchText: Docker is an abomination caused by availability of cheap hardware. I think I was raised to think of disk, CPU and RAM as food, and docker makes me feel the same as throwing away bags with uneaten food, a crime that was punishable by death at my childhood home i've merged more graceful handling, will watch the build and make sure the docker image gets pushed and let you know 🙂 Can teku handle now v1.3.0-rc.0? just building to check now i've been on holidays, so who knows i guess 😄 doesnt look like we're passing it yet, looks like there's some kind of block structure difference from alpha0, at least on minimal, will have to see if anyone is running with that docker image at least is published... It might be an erigon issue as other cls also struggle (LH and nimbus) Wait till you hear about kubernetes I swear I was going to mention something along the lines, but when I joined prysmaticlabs they made me sign a document saying that I can't speak badly of Bazel and K8s We wrote our own compiler 😀 in the history of regretting life choices... 🙂 patches welcome
